name: Muramite Citadel: Arena
summary: A brutal combat pit where prisoners are tested, broken, or executed under Muramite command.
description: The Arena is the Muramite Legion’s ritual combat chamber, execution pit, and proving ground. Prisoners are dragged here for trials by combat, ritual torment, or public execution. Muramite champions train and demonstrate dominance, while Inquisitors channel Discord energy into the arena floor to empower combat rituals. The terrain is jagged, blood‑scarred, and saturated with unstable arcane wards. Dragorn resistance infiltrators rarely survive entry.
